check.en: Open the image and check the explicit continuity details in the brief.
check.es: Abre la imagen y comprueba los detalles de continuidad indicados en el expediente.

check.en: Compare front, side and back; check that each intended view is in the exported package.
check.es: Compara el frente, el perfil y la espalda y comprueba que cada vista prevista esté en el paquete exportado.

check.en: Play the assembled cut, verify its duration and shot fingerprints, and check each continuity detail in the first, middle and last frame of each shot.
check.es: Reproduce el montaje, comprueba su duración y las huellas de los planos y revisa cada detalle de continuidad en el primer fotograma, el intermedio y el último.

name: Prospero's Hoard
purpose: Directs a media studio (ComfyUI, ffmpeg, TTS) to produce consistent characters (model sheets, local LoRA training, portable character packs), photocards, album art, beat-cut music videos as resumable productions and reusable recipes, narrated vertical shorts from a topic or a script (voice-over, word-by-word captions, stock or generated pictures, ducked music), cloned voices, audiobooks and dubbed video. Owns complete native timeline editing, subtitle and text editing, creative engines and revisioned audiovisual project transfer, with independent demand-start modules.
capabilities: scene video with anchored shots, continuity reviews and targeted retakes
QR films with exhaustive decoding of every encoded frame
manim scenes (2D maths and 3D animation drawn by code)
promo videos from a web page (brand scan, checked contact sheet, numpy sound)
real website walkthrough recordings with navigation, captions and contact sheets
timeline export to the video editor
code-rendered title cards and kinetic lyrics
edit plans as fingerprinted ffmpeg commands (plan, run, verify, delete)
delete HTML motion compositions with every revision and render
platform delivery verification (Shorts, Reels, TikTok, YouTube; EBU R128 loudness)
ComfyUI workflow preflight (missing nodes and model files)
treatment-first productions (logline, structures, shot list, beat sheet, approve and render)
continuity bible with revisions and stale shots
segment repair with frame-identical untouched GOPs
staleness per repaired range (a repair with the current revisions clears only the range it replaced)
region repair (a rectangle or a correction's region) with region review
a line in a bible voice spoken in a repaired range
regenerate stale shots: plan, new take, spliced only over the stale ranges
join review (black, frozen, colour jump, audio click and level jump) with seam strips
notes: A media studio: characters, generated photocards/covers, songs, beat-cut music videos as resumable productions and reusable recipes, narrated shorts with stock or generated pictures, cloned voices, audiobooks and dubbed video, driven through ComfyUI/ffmpeg/TTS/STT. Does not host any model itself. It tells the family hub when a production waits for a take or the animatic, finishes or fails (notify.via auto|hub|off, GPU jobs hold the hub's lease unless PROSPERO_GPU_LEASE=0), can open a production's cut in the video editor (production_export_lumiere), and takes cast members, storyboards and text-to-speech from the other apps.
